scores.evidence: Kallai p. 173 R, site 65: a water pool and remains of the roofing vault adjoin the church on its east (צמוד לכנסיה, ממזרח). p. 172 L: the Byzantine church (14 x 10.5 m) stands at the foot of the tell on its west side (לרגלי התל, בצדו המערבי). So the only pool on the pages is at the western foot of the tell, between church and tell: not east of the tell, and not in its eastern part (either sense of D-E11-EAST-SENSE). No date attaches to the pool; the periods are a site-wide sherd list. Excludes c06, c07, c09, c10.

Same as the decision row: Kallai places the pool W of the tell (adjoining the church at the tell's western foot), which meets the two-sided contradiction criterion 'W, S or N of the tell'. Held by the decision classes; not counted again in the chain metric.

Kallai p. 172 L, site 65 covers the tell and its north side: the tell is cut off from the ridge on the north by a rock-cut moat (חפיר חצוב). No cistern, pit, shaft or tomb is described in the north sector, and there is no statement that none exists. The Lapp 1966 Dhahr Mirzbaneh footnote (p. 173 R) gives no position.

Kallai p. 173 R, site 66 (Kh. Samiyye, 1817 1550, 400 m S of site 65) names no pool or basin. It gives remains of a water mill 300 m to the NE, with no stated reference point. No statement that there is no pool east, so the two-sided contradiction is not met; nothing registers an open basin, so confirmation is not met.
Kallai pp. 172 L–173 R, site 65 describes the tell (buildings, the rock-cut-stepped 'bama' on the summit, retaining walls) but no pit and no tomb on it.

P60-T3 follows the Kallai decision rows; the row scored is dec:bearing-or-phase-miss:not-east+undated (Kallai p. 173 R, p. 172 L). No pit or shaft north of the tell with tombs at its mouth is described (p. 172 L).

unregistered_observations: Kallai does not call the site 65 pool rock-cut. The text has 'a water pool and remains of the roofing vault' (בריכת מים ושרידי קמרון הקירוי), most naturally a covered (vaulted) pool. The project's label 'Kallai's rock-cut pool' did not come from these pages; its origin should be traced. The only rock-cut features at site 65 are the summit 'bama' steps and the northern moat (p. 172 L).

Kallai pp. 172 L–173 R (site 65) does not mention a crypt or a basin inside the church. Whether his pool east of the church and Zohar's church-crypt basin at the spring (IEJ 30 p. 219, SW of the tell) are the same feature is not settled by these pages.

Kallai p. 173 R, site 65: a built aqueduct crosses Wadi Siʿ about 300 m east of an undefined 'road', standing about 3 m above the bed, and many water mills lie along the stream. Site 66: water-mill remains 300 m NE. None is dated or placed relative to the tell. The site-66 mill lies about at the 45° edge of the S1667 east sector; it is not a pool.
Kallai p. 173 R: site 65 refers to the Introduction for the identification (not received).
notes: The church's position at the tell's western foot was already exposed (Highlands p. 733, citing Kallai); the pool's position east of the church was not repeated in Highlands or HA 76, so the decisive fact is new.
